resources.string: Country days could not be loaded. Try again.

Each local date counts once per country. Travel days can count in more than one country. Open visits and unverified departures count only the arrival date; route points can add other dates. Gaps are not filled.
Network geocoding is disabled. Enable it in Settings to analyze locations, or add manual stays.
Unresolved points: %1$s. Unresolved visits: %2$s. A verified country and local time zone are required; these locations are excluded from recorded totals.
Analyze saved locations to identify their countries. Completed results are saved on this phone.
Add missing dates or known stays. Overlapping dates count only once.
Preview shows the first 100 local dates. Export country CSV includes all dates in the selected period and requires verified lifetime access.

Coordinates are sent to your device’s geocoding service to identify countries. Geographic time zones are calculated on this phone from bundled boundaries. Results are estimates; unavailable locations stay unresolved. You can stop and continue later.
Waiting before the next lookup. You can stop and continue later.
No saved locations need analysis right now. Unavailable results retry after an hour.
